title: Direction label bar v1 (price-derived)
description: Supervised label row aligned to exchange calendar date and horizon. Join to news_observation_v1 only under explicit walk-forward rules (no lookahead). Research-only unless promoted elsewhere.

label_date.description: Trading calendar date for the label (tz rules documented by corpus).

direction.description: Class including neutral band policy hashed into label_sha256.

label_sha256.description: Hash over canonical label inputs (OHLCV slice version, neutral_bps, horizon, instrument).

neutral_bps.description: Optional: neutral band width in basis points used when deriving direction.
